symptom: At the mobile production viewport the long review-first proposal contained decision controls in the DOM but the fixed-height route root used overflow hidden, so a real user could not scroll to Accept or Reject.
rootCause: The query route reused the shared fixed 100dvh ViewContainer without an inner scroll owner; an equal-specificity CSS module rule initially lost to the shared overflow rule, requiring a route-specific attribute selector.
fix: Added agentView to the query route and enforced overflow-y:auto with selector specificity; verified a real wheel gesture reaches the pending controls and durable receipt at 390x844.
